name: blindqa
description: blindqa — human-like QA for web apps that re-tests only what changed.

plugins.name: blindqa
plugins.description: Human-like QA for any web app: Playwright drives it like a person on whatever browser this machine has (local, headless, CDP, n.eko, Orca), scripts do every check and re-test only what code changes touch, and nothing it writes ever reaches a git remote.
